verdict.rationale: Gitea documents a public API/webhooks for building custom workflows and even provides an official CLI ('tea') and an official MCP server for AI-agent integration, all strong agenticness signals. However, probes for standard machine-discoverable API specs (llms.txt, openapi/swagger.json) at docs.gitea.com all returned 404, suggesting the API isn't easily discoverable in a standardized format even though it exists.
